title: pvPartitionedLegacyVTKReader
body:
## pvPartitionedLegacyVTKReader

Reads a partitioned legacy VTK data set: a .pvtk summary file listing several legacy .vtk piece files (structured points, structured, rectilinear or unstructured grid, or polydata), which are read as one data set. Use it for older parallel outputs; use pvLegacyVTKReader for a single .vtk file and the XML partitioned readers (e.g. pvXMLPartitionedUnstructuredGridReader) for .pvtu or .pvtp data.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The pieces are found through the summary file; keep them with it when moving the data.
- FileName takes one path, so this reader has no file-series mode.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `PartitionedLegacyVTKReader`. Identity: `sources/pvtkfile`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file name for the Partitioned Legacy VTK reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvPartitionedLegacyVTKReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
